=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- CLAUDE.md:102-104 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The clear-winner exclusion list omits explicit ask-first rules elsewhere in the file, leaving conflicting instructions about when a session must stop and ask.
  WHY: The highest severity was BLOCKER; reviewers disagreed, rating it MAJOR and NIT as well, and one characterized it as an interpretive conflict with no observed behavior break. The omission affects the pre-task STOP rule and the missing-resource-identifier ask rules in §22.C and §24.F.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The subsection applies only when "nothing else in the file makes it ask-first."
  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md lines 102-104
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: CLAUDE.md:24 (pre-task STOP rule), CLAUDE.md:1020 (§22.C "Ask when missing" for DigitalOcean IDs), CLAUDE.md:1527 (§24.F "Ask when missing" for Cloudflare identifiers); the PR diff adds no reconciliation for those existing requirements.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- CLAUDE.md: lines 102-104 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clear-winner exclusion list omits several ask-first rules, leaving an interpretive conflict about whether they remain in force.
  WHY: The list could be read as exhaustive, although the general clause and other criteria reduce the likelihood of an incorrect assumption.

- Requirement: The PR description says a decision is a clear winner only when "nothing else in the file makes it ask-first".
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md lines 102-104.
  Evidence of absence: The delivered list covers §6, §10, §12.D, §18.A, §18.D, §22.B, §23.C, §24.D, §29.B and data deletion. It has no mention of CLAUDE.md:24 (the pre-task stop), §22.C (:1020), §24.F (:1527) or the :1378 and :306 stops. The general clause still covers them, so this is the same NIT-level point as the finding above, restated for lens completeness.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- CLAUDE.md: lines 102-104 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clear-winner exclusion list omits several mandatory ask-first rules defined in this file.
  WHY: An AI agent might incorrectly make a clear-winner decision for actions that explicitly require user input, such as supplying missing DigitalOcean resource IDs (§22.C), missing Cloudflare identifiers (§24.F), or when pre-task context is missing (pre-task rule at line 18).

- Requirement: The new subsection makes a decision a clear winner only when "nothing else in the file makes it ask-first: §6 renames and removals, §10 DB / index / contract changes, §12.D, §18.A manual scripts, §18.D gates, §22.B, §23.C, §24.D and §29.B operations, or any deletion of data." (delivered verbatim at CLAUDE.md:102-104). The PR description intends this to cover all ask-first rules.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md lines 102-104
  Evidence of absence: The delivered text omits the "Ask when missing" rules for DigitalOcean resource IDs (§22.C, CLAUDE.md:1020) and Cloudflare identifiers (§24.F, CLAUDE.md:1527), as well as the pre-task mandatory-context-loading rule ("If any are missing or unclear: STOP and ask... Never assume undocumented behavior.", CLAUDE.md:24). Consequently, the exclusion list is incomplete regarding the stated intent to cover all ask-first rules.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- CLAUDE.md: §2 “Clear-Winner Assumptions,” lines 102-104 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rule says a clear-winner decision must not be ask-first elsewhere in the file, but its exclusion list omits explicit ask-first requirements in §22.C and §24.F, as well as the pre-task STOP-and-ask rule at lines 24-25.
  WHY: An interactive session applying the listed exclusions as exhaustive can treat a decision as eligible for assumption even when the pre-task rule requires asking about missing or unclear context, or §§22.C/24.F require asking for an unavailable resource identifier.

- Requirement: “A decision is a clear winner only when” it is “not ask-first anywhere else in this file.”
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §2 “Clear-Winner Assumptions,” lines 102-104.
  Evidence of absence: The new exclusion list does not account for the pre-task STOP-and-ask rule at lines 24-25 or the missing-identifier ask requirements in §22.C and §24.F. The PR diff adds no reconciliation for those existing requirements.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- CLAUDE.md: lines 102-104 (fourth clear-winner bullet); conflicting sites: line 24, line 1020, line 1527 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clear-winner bullet's operative checklist omits standing ask-first rules in §22.C and §24.F and the pre-task context-loading STOP rule.
  WHY: A session may proceed without required confirmation when it treats the list as the file's ask-first set; §24.F requires asking for an unrecorded Cloudflare identifier.

- Requirement: PR description — the subsection applies only when "nothing else in the file makes it ask-first," delivered at CLAUDE.md:102-104 as an enumeration of exactly those rules ("§6 renames and removals, §10 DB / index / contract changes, §12.D, §18.A manual scripts, §18.D gates, §22.B, §23.C, §24.D and §29.B operations, or any deletion of data").
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md lines 102-104 (the fourth clear-winner bullet).
  Evidence of absence: No hunk adds §22.C's "Ask when missing" ask rule (CLAUDE.md:1020), §24.F's "Ask when missing" rule (CLAUDE.md:1527), or the PRE-TASK context-loading STOP rule (CLAUDE.md:24) to the exclusion list, so the delivered text under-covers the file's own ask-first set that the intent phrase requires. Same defect as the CORRECTNESS finding above; reported here for lens completeness.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
